questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Hymenolepis nana?
options: Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Embryonated eggs in stool. Concentrated wet mount at 400× to resolve polar filaments; assess several focal planes.
